_provenance: phase2/clockless/rtl_n256.py --N 256 --M 4 --degree 16 --radius 3 --trials 240 --seed 11, run once with --delay transport and once with --delay inertial. Same network, same espresso SOPs (12,357 terms), same DSATUR colouring (chi=4, delays = class+1 = 1..4), same 240 vectors. iverilog 12.
inertial_model: assign #(d) s_del[i] = d_in[i]  (continuous assignment with delay: a pending change is cancelled if the input reverts before d elapses)
transport_model: s_settle[i] <= #(d) s_next[i]  (nonblocking intra-assignment delay: every event delivered)
